## Requirement IDs stamped

- **Owned:** `SIG-TRANSP-005` (run history), `SIG-TRANSP-008` (dossier contribution), `SIG-TRANSP-040` (assignment basis), `SIG-TRANSP-041` (file-action disclosure), `SIG-TRANSP-043` (published-entity browse)
- **Cited:** `SIG-UI-039` (T-page contract), `SIG-UI-040` (ADR-155 posture), `SIG-ENG-042` (fail-loud surfaces), `SIG-DSRC-008` (one shared artifact ⇒ equal numbers)
- **Carried verbatim:** `D-J3-2 [B-19] = yes` (scrubbed run logs publish; a robots disregard discloses host + count + the GL-GATE-08 reference only — never raw logs or per-URL detail) · `D-K9-2 [B-22] = a` (manifest-only prior releases) · `D-K10-2` (entity browse cap stated with the total)

## What lands

- **`/sources/<id>/runs/` + `…/page/<n>/`** — every recorded execution, newest first, one `<details>` per run (times, outcome, mode/kind, claims + fetch counts, rejects/errors/document outcomes by class, disappearances, rate-limit/quota/budget, code identity, link+clock basis). `sig.source-runs/1` twin.
- **`/sources/<id>/captures/` + `…/changes/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`)** — every capture occurrence (full UTC time, digest, bytes, records, media type, classification, K9 §5.4 change kind, http status, storage/lane state) plus the J3 §5.3 file-action cell (`captureFileAction` mirrors `exports.statements.capture_view_original`); `changes/` holds only record-set changes. `sig.source-captures/1` twins.
- **`/sources/<id>/versions/`** — P36.68's `sig.source-versions/1` rendered: latest extract files + the per-release entries table (extract / extract_absent / manifest_only `not_republished`) + diffs; twin = the document verbatim.
- **`/sources/<id>/entities/` + `…/page/<n>/`** — published entities citing the source, `data-entity-id` rows for the page_index seam, capped 10×100 with total + cap stated (D-K10-2); `sig.source-entities/1` twin.
- **`/sources/<id>/dossiers/`** — the shared `contributions` mirror verbatim with assignment basis per row; `sig.source-dossier-contributions/1` twin.
- **`/sources/<id>/index.json`** — the `sig.source-page/2` twin (row + summaries + sub-route links), plus a `SourceSubnav` on every page-B surface; the index gains the page-B sections block.
- **Model:** `web/src/lib/source-page-b.ts` — seams read `transparency/captures.jsonl` (or the per-source stream), `versions.json`, and the published-entity derivation; missing artifacts are honest absences, never fabricated rows. Registry-only sources (S-11) emit no sub-route.
- **check-figures:** `transparency/sources/<id>/{versions,index,entities}.json` + `captures.jsonl` pattern-admitted (pinned pair in `figures.ts`/`check-figures.mjs`); `data.ts` + `artifact/[...path].json.ts` serve the per-source payloads; the `<id>/<sub>` row surfaces are row data per the DSRC-02 precedent (`SOURCE_ROW_SEGMENTS`) — the material figures live in each page's `figures[]`, contract-checked at build.
- **Tests:** `tests/unit/source-page-b.test.ts` (file-action matrix, changes filter, sort/pagination/cap, validators, S-11 exclusion) + `tests/e2e/source-page-b.spec.ts` (routes, pagination, file-action cells, twins, entity cap, registry-only 404).

No production mutation, no gate item, no OM-20 leg; `live_verification=false`. `D-P36.68-1` (P36.68's mirror write) is untouched and stays OPEN.
